newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU-Russia summit set for March 3.
newsitem.headline: EU-Russia summit set for March 3.

text.p: A summit meeting between the European Union and Russian President Boris Yeltsin, postponed in February due to Yeltsin's ill-health, has been rescheduled for March 3 in Moscow, a European Commission spokesman said on Friday.
"We have just heard that this will take place on March 3 in Moscow," Commission spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas told a news conference.
The summit was originally due to be held on February 4 in The Hague but Yeltsin had not recovered sufficiently from a bout of pneumonia following his heart operation.
